date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the page gives no earlier day for the forum post.
title: Decathlon confirms malicious access to customer personal data at an external provider; hacker "4me1" claims forum post, headline cites 137 000 email addresses
summary: Decathlon confirmed to Ouest-France "un accès malveillant à des données personnelles", at one of its external service providers, according to generation-nt. A hacker calling themselves "4me1" claims to have posted customer data on a forum; MCE TV's headline, relaying Capital.fr, puts the exposed email addresses at 137 000. Generation-nt says Decathlon plans to notify the CNIL and affected customers by email.
plain: Decathlon has confirmed, according to generation-nt, that someone gained malicious access to customers' personal data at an external provider. A hacker claims to have posted the data, including 137 000 email addresses, on a forum.
exec: Decathlon confirmed malicious access to customer personal data at an external provider, per generation-nt; a hacker's forum post is said to include 137 000 email addresses.
action: MCE TV advises being wary of unexpected messages about an order or parcel, not clicking links in suspicious SMS or emails, and checking on the official Decathlon site or app.
